selected_branches.branch: Stopping or standing within a highway tunnel.
required_context: Vehicle-accessible tunnel interior, portals, boundaries and destination inside it.

Other vehicle's actual location, motion and purpose.

law_text: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device, in any of the following places: Upon any bridge or other elevated structure or within a highway tunnel.
